vulnerabilities.description: No vulnerabilities found in this code.

The application does not check the return value of Runtime.exec() which can lead to security issues such as command injection attacks.
To mitigate this issue, you should always use a whitelist or sanitize user input before passing it into exec(). For example: cmd = Utils.getInsecureOSCommandString(this.getClass().getClassLoader()); argsEnv[0] = org.owasp.benchmark.helpers.Utils.sanitizeForShell(param);

The SQL statement is not parameterized, which makes the application vulnerable to SQL Injection attacks.
To prevent this vulnerability you should use a prepared statement or parameterize your query.
